narrative: During this period, balloobbot increased output significantly, with merged PRs rising by 155.6% to 23 and reviews given surging to 66. However, median cycle time lengthened drastically by 1,085.2% to 32.0 hours as the contributor took on much larger PRs averaging 202 lines changed. The data suggests that shifting towards substantially bigger integration items created a review and merging bottleneck, slowing down overall delivery speed despite the higher volume of work.
root_cause_hypothesis: The shift toward much larger PR sizes and a massive increase in reviews given created a review bottleneck, driving up cycle times.

evidence_chain.claim: Median cycle time increased to 32.0 hours
Median PR size rose to 202 lines changed
